title: Adelphi in London
html_source: Founded in 1806 as the Sans Pareil (“Without Compare”), by merchant John Scott, and his daughter Jane (1770–1839). The old theatre was demolished, and on 26 December 1858 The New Adelphi was opened and was considered an improvement on the cramped circumstances of the original. The new theatre could seat 1,500 people, with standing room for another 500. The building was renovated in 1879 and again in 1887. The present Adelphi opened on 3 December 1930.
